top_signals.title: Rotation From Leveraged ETFs Fuel 30% Jump in Korea Small Caps
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s small-cap stocks are regaining investor interest after lagging larger peers for much of the year, as restrictions on leveraged exchanged-traded funds tracking heavyweight chipmakers shift money toward Kosdaq names.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Italy’s record-low Po River forces farmers to weigh crop switch
top_signals.summary: The river's climate change-fueled violent swings between flood and drought is also forcing industries to compete for a resource they once took for granted.
